description.value: Quesada Burritos & Tacos is a Canadian Mexican fast food chain offering customizable burritos, tacos, quesadillas, and nachos with a range of proteins and signature toppings like pickled red onions and hand-mashed guacamole. It operates as a Foodtastic franchise with locations across Canada, including this Vancouver Island unit. A touring cyclist stopping here can expect a quick, filling meal with online or in-store ordering.
